description: Weapon still-life in camp: a THOMPSON SUBMACHINE GUN (front pistol grip — M1928-pattern) stands propped muzzle-up against a dark wooden post on grass, sling hanging, box magazine inserted, its wooden stock planted by a sandbag revetment at left. Behind: a grey quonset-style hut with window, an open-sided shed with stacked lumber, a tipped drum, grass and worn paths — the domestic middle of the camp.
setting: A posed portrait OF the weapon itself — someone's assigned Thompson photographed like a comrade. Matches the Thompsons seen in VN-0013 and VN-0028; support troops carried these before M16 issue.
landmarkHypotheses: Same camp as the quonset/tent cluster frames (VN-0027 area).
